sources.title: Voyage 4 nano - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: voyage-4-nano is a lightweight open-weight text embedding model from the Voyage 4 series. It features a 32,000-token context window, 340M total parameters, multilingual support, Matryoshka flexible dimensions (256 to 2048), quantization-aware training, and a shared embedding space compatible with all other Voyage 4 models. Licensed under Apache 2.0.

sources.title: voyage 4 nano — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: Compact and efficient, Voyage 4 Nano is the lightweight member of the Voyage embedding family — optimized for speed and low resource consumption without sacrificing too much retrieval quality. It excels at turning text into dense vector representations quickly, making it practical for high-throughput pipelines or memory-constrained environments.
